sentences.text: Date : 14.11. 2023 Heard Mr. D. Medhi, learned counsel for the petitioner and Mr. MP Goswami,
Public Prosecutor for the State respondent

. 
Page No.# 2/2 This is an application under Section 438 Cr.P.C., filed by the petitioner seeking pre-arrest bail, apprehending arrest in connection with Mayong P.S. Case No. 93/2023 under Sections 354/ 376 AB IPC read with Sections 4/ 6 of POCSO Act.
Call for the case diary alongwith the statement of the victim recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C. and medical report.
Issue notice to the respondent No. 2.
The petitioner has prayed for to take steps for service of notice through dasti mode of service.
The notice be served through dasti mode of service and after service, an affidavit be filed to that effect.
